release_channel: pre-release (newest published build; 0.47.0 is the newest stable)
extra_pip_specs: datasets>=3.0.0,<4.0.0 soundfile librosa pyarrow psutil zstandard fire nvidia-ml-py requests
extra_pip_specs_reason: Whisper calibration streams MLCommons/peoples_speech audio, which datasets 3.x decodes with soundfile (datasets 4.x would need torchcodec + FFmpeg). pyarrow loads the reranker calibration JSONL; requests is imported by modelopt.torch.utils.dataset_utils; psutil/zstandard/fire/nvidia-ml-py come from examples/hf_ptq.
scope: Campaign for public issue HangGlidersRule/model-forge#14 (Qwen3-Reranker-4B, whisper-large-v3-turbo). configs/modelopt/pin.json (0.46.0rc2) still governs the earlier families and their shipped artifacts.
why_this_release: Newest published ModelOpt (Devin asked for the latest). Fixes over 0.47.0 that matter here: hf_ptq no longer overwrites an existing pad_token with eos_token; export copies the source checkpoint's non-model files unchanged; calibration no longer silently drops samples on an OOM batch split; FP8 fake-quant no longer zeroes tiny static NVFP4 weight blocks. Recipe units used here (nvfp4, nvfp4_static, base_disable_all) are byte-identical to 0.47.0; default_disabled_quantizers only adds two GatedDeltaNet emulation exclusions.

verified.wheel_sha256: computed locally from the downloaded wheel, matches PyPI
verified.recipes: all four issue-14 recipes load with modelopt.recipe.load_recipe under 0.48.0rc1 and 0.47.0
verified.speech_calibration: MLCommons/peoples_speech clean streams and decodes with datasets 3.6.0 + soundfile
